subject.title: [Feature]: Add an optional result-return mode for /hooks/agent

question: Should OpenClaw add a synchronous result-return mode to `POST /hooks/agent`, and if yes should the permanent API be the linked PR's `waitForResult`/`announceToMain` shape?
rationale: This changes a stable gateway HTTP surface and security-sensitive hook behavior; automation can verify the gap but cannot choose the product/security contract.

options.title: Adopt the linked PR shape after security hardening
options.body: Use `waitForResult` plus `announceToMain` if maintainers accept the synchronous hook contract and require the PR to address output, timeout, replay, and error-disclosure concerns before merge.

options.title: Choose a different synchronous contract
options.body: Ask the contributor to reshape the implementation around a dedicated sync endpoint or result URL if that is safer or clearer than extending the current endpoint.

options.title: Decline the core API for now
options.body: Keep the documented async `/hooks/agent` plus `sessions_history` workaround and close the linked PR if maintainers decide the synchronous callback surface is not wanted.

recommendation.title: Adopt the linked PR shape after security hardening
recommendation.body: Use `waitForResult` plus `announceToMain` if maintainers accept the synchronous hook contract and require the PR to address output, timeout, replay, and error-disclosure concerns before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history shows the most work on the central hook files, and the decision spans gateway API/product boundaries rather than a single narrow defect.
